better_answer_example: In my final year of IT undergraduate studies, I developed a strong interest in UI UX design, particularly in creating user-friendly interfaces. One project that stands out was designing a sales analytics dashboard for a small business. I worked collaboratively with my team to identify the client's needs and created prototypes using Figma. We conducted user testing, which helped us refine the design and address UI consistency issues. Through this project, I learned the importance of iterative design and effective teamwork. I believe this experience has prepared me for a role in UI UX design, where I can apply my skills and knowledge to create innovative solutions.
